_note: Approved/limited_use snapshot only. Not the full research dataset. A phrase here is a candidate to consider when it fits the exact meaning, platform, audience and register of the copy you're writing — never insert it just because it's listed.

phrases.usage_guidance: User-authorized fast-track promotion (2026-07-31), overriding the standard same-pass-insertion hold given the strength of the volume evidence. Pair with 'Facebook' rather than replace it (e.g. 'Facebook（FB）符號') -- do not use 'FB' as a standalone primary title/H1 term; the hreflang cluster is keyed to the full Facebook concept.
phrases.good_example: Facebook（FB）符號大全 — 反應・愛心符號複製貼上
phrases.avoid_when: formal/legal copy needing the full brand name; do not use as a standalone term without the Facebook pairing since FB is ambiguous out of context

phrases.register: everyday/colloquial; standard in TW speech and consumer contexts
phrases.content_surface: title, H1, meta description, FAQ, alternateName
